content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Roorkee Project Consultant position is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical engineering and be a BEE Certified Energy Auditor, along with a minimum of 25 years of work experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 250000.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Consultant job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be sent via email. Ensure you attach all required documents and send the email before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies released by IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee has released a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Consultant post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Consultant role at IIT Roorkee will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q10. What is the notification date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for this recruitment was released on 09 September 2026.
